1514.summary: The class discusses the concept of the way of holiness, drawing from Isaiah 35 and other scriptures. It explores the idea of a safe and smooth path to the kingdom, emphasizing the need for personal and ecclesial commitment to stay on this path.

1515.summary: The class discusses the destination of the kingdom of God, emphasizing the importance of understanding and valuing the kingdom's characteristics to stay on the way of holiness. It focuses on the aspects of the kingdom such as peace, justice, and the absence of pain and sorrow, and encourages diligence in seeking God.

1516.summary: The class discusses the importance of holiness and righteousness in daily life, emphasizing the seamless integration of godly pursuits into regular routines. It highlights the need for regular Bible reading, prayer, and service to others, and encourages a natural flow of faith into actions without hesitation.

1517.summary: The class explores the parable of the Good Samaritan from Luke 10, emphasizing the importance of loving one's neighbor and extending help to those in need. It highlights Christ's role as a surprising source of help and the sacrificial nature of his ministry, encouraging believers to follow his example in their own lives.
